The applicant has filed this First bail application under Section 482 of BNSS/438 of Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail.

Applicant apprehends his arrest in connection with Crime No.346/2025 registered at Police Station University District Gwalior (M.P.) in relation to the offence punishable under Sections 420, 467,
468, 471, 120B of IPC.

As per prosecution case, complainant Smt. Sudha Singh submitted a written complaint to the Superintendent of Police, Gwalior, stating therein that she is a resident of House Nos. 14-15, Sharda Vihar Colony, Mahalgaon, University District, Gwalior, and that she is the owner of agricultural land bearing Survey Nos. 83/2, 147/2, 148/2, 172 Min 5, 173 Min 3, and 178 Min 4, comprising six plots with a total area of 2.383 hectares, situated at Village Sekri, Patwari Halka No. 13 Vanheri, Tehsil Ghatigaon, District Gwalior.

It NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-GWL:239 2 MCRC-60238-2025 was further stated that the said land was purchased by her from Vijaypal through a registered sale deed dated 08.08.2003, and the possession thereof was also delivered to her.

In May 2025, when she reached the said land along with her driver, she found Jitendra Singh Rawat and other persons present on the agricultural land, whereupon she informed them that the Mangal Singh Rawat vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 5 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/45922599/
1 land belonged to her and questioned them as to why they were demolishing the boundary ridges of the agricultural land.

sentences.text: Thereupon, Jitendra Singh Rawat along with 8-9 other persons restrained her from entering the land and showed her a photocopy of a registered sale deed, claiming that the land had been purchased from Sudha Singh, wife of Ramlakhan, on 18.10.2022.

The complainant then stated that she herself is Sudha Singh Singhal and that she had never sold the said land, whereafter the said persons threatened her, stating that if she came there again, she would be killed.

Subsequently, the complainant obtained information from the Revenue Department and the Office of the Sub-Registrar, Gwalior, regarding the registered sale deed dated 18.10.2022, and came to know that Jitendra Singh Rawat, Arvind Singh, Upendra and Hemant, in collusion with Kiran Bai and Dinesh and Chhatrapal, and Mangal Singh Rawat, in collusion with Dinesh Singh and Arvind Singh, had all, pursuant to a criminal conspiracy, and in association with an unknown woman bearing Aadhaar No. 6988 6684 2348, prepared forged documents and, by impersonating the complainant through the said unknown woman, caused registered sale deeds in respect of Survey Nos. 83 Min 2, 172 Min 5 and 148/2 Min 1 to be executed on 18.10.2022, 02.11.2022 and 02.11.2022 respectively, by colluding with the Sub-Registrar Kailash NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2026:MPHC-GWL:239 3 MCRC-60238-2025 Narayan Verma, and thereafter got the mutation entries effected and further mortgaged the said land with the State Bank of India, whereas the complainant had never sold any portion of the said land, and the accused persons, in conspiracy with the unknown woman and public officials, had caused fraudulent sale deeds to be executed.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case.
It is contended that even prior to the registration of the present offence, the applicant had approached the authorities by submitting written complaints regarding the alleged fraud.

In this regard, applications were made before the SDOP Office, Tehsil Ghatigaon, District Gwalior on 09.06.2025; before the Station House Officer, University Police Station on 06.06.2025; and earlier before the Superintendent of Police, Gwalior on 06.05.2025.
It is further submitted that a registered sale deed has been duly executed in favour of the applicant by Sudha Singh, and therefore, the applicant himself is the aggrieved party in the transaction.

It is further submitted that the applicant is a permanent resident of District Gwalior, has deep roots in society, and there is no likelihood of his absconding or influencing the prosecution witnesses.
The applicant has expressed his willingness to cooperate with the investigation and trial and has undertaken not to cause any harassment or intimidation to the complainant or the witnesses.

On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the application, submitting that the allegations pertain to serious offences of forgery, impersonation and criminal conspiracy involving valuable NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-GWL:239 4 MCRC-60238-2025 immovable property, and that custodial interrogation of the applicant may be necessary to unearth the larger conspiracy.
Heard the counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.

Keeping in view the overall facts and circumstances, the nature of allegations, the submissions advanced by learned counsel for the parties, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this Court is inclined to allow the application.

The applicant will not indulge herself/himself in extending inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to the Police Officer, as the case may be.
4. The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused;
5. The applicant will not seek unnecessary adjournments during the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-GWL:239 5 MCRC-60238-2025 trial;

6. The applicant will not leave India without previous permission of the trial Court/Investigating Officer, as the case may be;
